definitions.explanation: Quick to detect or respond to slight changes, signals, or influences. Can refer to physical sensitivity (skin, allergies) or emotional/social awareness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{寒|さむ}さ→寒さ：12336_samusa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{敏感|びんかん}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{感情|かんじょう}→感情：00171_kanjou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧{敏感|びんかん}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: She's very sensitive to other people's feelings.

examples.japanese: {敏感|びんかん}⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦なので→なので：29354_nanode⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{化粧品|けしょうひん}→化粧品：05119_keshouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{使|つか}えない→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I have sensitive skin, so I can't use this cosmetic.

notes:
USAGE:
Describes heightened responsiveness to stimuli, whether physical or emotional.
- {敏感|びんかん}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a sensitive person)
- {敏感|びんかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{反応|はんのう}→反応：04812_hannou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to react sensitively)
Unlike the often negative connotation of "sensitive" in English (oversensitive, touchy), {敏感|びんかん} is neutral to positive, implying awareness and responsiveness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {敏感|びんかん}⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧ (sensitive skin - very common in cosmetic advertising)
- {敏感|びんかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{察知|さっち}→察知：21208_sacchi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to sense keenly)
- ⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{敏感|びんかん} (price-sensitive)
- ⟦{流行|りゅうこう}→流行：03678_ryuukou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{敏感|びんかん} (trend-conscious)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {敏感|びんかん} ↔ ⟦{鈍感|どんかん}→鈍感：06640_donkan⟧ (sensitive ↔ insensitive)
